spotlight.name: Fernando Sepúlveda Sagaseta
spotlight.detail: Senior · Business & Engineering · UM Student Government President
spotlight.quote: At AKPsi I was surrounded by the most driven people on campus, each with completely different career aspirations. We've taught each other hard work, and how to lead with perspective. Without them, I wouldn't be where I am.

philanthropy.blurb: Beta Pi's philanthropy is suicide prevention. We raise money, start honest conversations about mental health, and make sure every Cane knows where to turn when things get heavy.

initiatives.title: Awareness Walk
initiatives.text: We walk together each year to honor those we've lost and raise funds for suicide prevention.

initiatives.title: Campus Conversations
initiatives.text: Panels, tabling, and workshops that make talking about mental health normal at the U.

initiatives.title: Fundraising
initiatives.text: Every dollar we raise supports prevention research, education, and support programs.

philanthropy.why: College can be a lot. Classes, recruiting, being away from home, and the pressure to have it all figured out can weigh on anyone, and too often people struggle quietly. We chose suicide prevention because every brother, every friend, and every Cane deserves to know they're not alone and that reaching out is a sign of strength.

supportSteps.title: Ask
supportSteps.text: If you're worried about someone, ask them directly how they're doing. Asking won't make things worse, and it shows you care.

supportSteps.title: Listen
supportSteps.text: Give them space to talk without judging or trying to fix everything. Just being there matters.

supportSteps.title: Connect
supportSteps.text: Help them reach support: the 988 Lifeline, the UM Counseling Center, or someone they trust.

supportSteps.title: Follow up
supportSteps.text: Check in again in a day or two. A quick text can mean more than you think.

ticker: It's okay to not be okay
